regressions.source: ERC1155 _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck: abi.encodeCall(onERC1155BatchReceived, (operator, from, ids, values, data))
regressions.issue: A held read _193 = mem[64] is no longer identified with the later read of mem[64] in the same block, so the offset keeps '_193 - mem[64]' (0). Overall such lines fell 51 -> 27 in this text, so this is local.
regressions.rule: Two reads of mem[64] with only stores at mem[64] + k (k >= 0, mem[64] above its constant floor) in between are equal; fold _193 - mem[64] to 0.

improvements: Singleton-array paths of the ERC1155 _update are resolved: the dead TransferBatch branch (with its two copy loops) and the dead ERC1155InvalidArrayLength revert are gone from unregister, unknowndfa70d8b, unknown7c300586 and unknown85f3e643, TransferSingle is decoded (value 1); onERC1155Received calls named instead of 'call address(y).mem[mem[64] len 4]'; custom errors decoded (0x4c9c8ce3, 0xaa1d49a4, 0xb398979f, 0xf74d7dd0, 0x57f447ce, 0x2a7b2d20, 0xf9165348) and proxiableUUID named in upgradeToAndCall; safeBatchTransferFrom's TransferBatch event, whose values argument was mis-decoded ('values=32 * ids.length + 96'), now shows both arrays; registry events carry their data; bytes call arguments split into length and data; hex constants show whole bytes.
notes: Diff of 2,667 lines reviewed by function: calls identical in count; event sites fewer only by the pruned TransferBatch branches (verified against unregister's old text: lengths are the constants 1 written two lines above); storage writes unchanged except key spelling (stor0[concat(mem[0])] -> the id read from the singleton array). The one-element _update loop stays a while with _117 = 1.
summary: No semantic regression; dead batch branches pruned, receiver calls, custom errors and events decoded, and a mis-decoded TransferBatch fixed. One line in safeBatchTransferFrom keeps an unsimplified '_193 - mem[64]'.
